messages:
Alex R: Quick sync: product wants per-customer insight tiles in Console — request rates, tail latency, quota usage, noisy neighbor flag. Need infra/runtime inputs. Who can help define metric contract? @Maria G @Jin Park

Maria G: We need strong isolation: no org-specific PII, metrics must be aggregated and only exposed to org admins. Also retention 90d by default. :lock:

Jin Park: From runtime side: we can emit per-org counters and percentiles, but attaching org_id to every span increases ingest cost. Can we use sampling + denormalized top-k tenants? Also we have KV-cache tags we can reuse.

Sam T: Quota team: per-org quota windows already exist. We can emit the usage tokens/min and overage_count per org. Important: quotas API is internal-only — will need a small endpoint for Console aggregation.

Alex R: Proposed metrics list: requests_total, requests_5xx, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, tokens_generated, queue_length, gpu_util_by_pool, noisy_neighbor_score. Any objections?

Jin Park: Works for runtime. Implementation note: p99 needs async aggregators to avoid pressure. Suggest running reservoir sampling per org for tail. We can also emit 'sampled_tail_count' to show confidence.

infra-bot: Example metric event schema (proposal):

```json
{
  "metric_name": "p99_latency_ms",
  "labels": ["org_id_safe", "region", "model_variant"],
  "value": 123.4,
  "sampled": true,
  "sample_size": 125
}
```

Maria G: On privacy: org_id_safe must be hashed with customer salt and only resolvable by Console using customer ACLs. No raw org_id in telemetry.

Sam T: Routing policy impact: when we route to fallback model, we should tag request with route_policy=fallback. Console needs to show % routed to fallback per org.

Jin Park: Agree. Also for noisy neighbor detection: combine sudden spike in queue_length + persistent increase in p95 + GPU_core_saturation > 0.8 across 5 mins. We'll emit 'noisy_neighbor_signal' 0..1.

Alex R: UX question: Do we want a per-org 'health badge' (green/yellow/red) and a 'why' tooltip with contributing metrics? Product likes that for SREs.

Maria G: Yes but only show detailed contributors to org admins and support. In UI we show aggregated reason categories to others.

Sam T: @Jin Park what's the rollout plan? We need canary signals before full rollout.

deploy-bot: canary-rollout: started for telemetry-metrics-v2 to 10% of traffic in us-west-2

Jin Park: Plan: rollout in phases — emit metrics with namespace 'preview.v2' for 24h, then switch producers. Need a feature flag in Console to read preview namespace.

Alex R: Action items: (1) Jin: PR for metric producers + sampling approach (2) Infra: API endpoint to aggregate per-org (3) Maria: privacy checklist and ACLs (4) Sam: quota metrics contract. Sync on Wed 11am. :thumbsup:
